notes: New: Party support on the Battle page, for a Priest in a party. It heals, buffs, cleanses and raises party members in the order you set and follows a member you choose, travelling to their map and channel, and it is off until you turn it on. Fixed: Strike Order changes save again, and Taunt every cooldown stays on after your character loads. Fixed: a second client's Start and Pause from the top bar are saved for that client, and the licence check no longer re applies its settings or resets its channel change timer. Fixed: restarting a stuck client closes and relaunches only that client, and a refused restart says why. Fixed: Low Resource Mode keeps its 20 FPS limit after town warps and map changes. Fixed: Boss Mode settings survive a profile migration or copy, and map exits wait for the new map to finish loading. Changed: a second client whose Start is saved resumes by itself when it reconnects, a second client's sandbox is checked before it launches, Boss Mode values are cleaned when saved, Boss Mode also stops a farm map return that walks through a map exit, and the administrator's licence tools are hidden in a customer install. After updating, close every game client once, wait half a minute with the Companion open, then start them again.
